exact_source_references.document_title: DHA Telehealth Clinical Guidelines for Virtual Management of Minor Head Injury

exact_section.heading: Section 7 — red flags
exact_section.evidence_summary: Lists loss of consciousness, seizure, repeated vomiting, drowsiness, worsening headache, amnesia, focal neurological or balance or speech or vision changes, skull or penetrating injury, bleeding disorder or anticoagulant use, intoxication, and non-accidental injury concerns.

exact_source_references.population_qualifier: Adults and children with minor head injury; red-flag, anticoagulated, non-accidental, or deteriorating presentations require escalation.
exact_source_references.setting_qualifier: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
